title: Instrument models are added but none drop out: all 37 common models still appear in 2025 deposits
sub:
Rows: every instrument model named in ≥50 public PRIDE datasets released 2013–2025 (35,770 model-labelled datasets; fractional credit when a dataset
names several models), ordered by first year with ≥3 datasets. Ridge height = √(share of that year’s model-labelled datasets), common scale. Thin
line = years with ≥1 dataset. Rows starting in 2013 are left-censored. A deposited label is not an ownership record; first year is not purchase.
